role: Deterministic, allocation-free C11 component lifecycle runtime
maturity: Host-tested C11 core; scheduling and target timing belong to the consuming application/platform.

layers.name: Interface contracts
layers.responsibility: Public APIs, ABIs, schemas, events and versioned formats.

layers.name: Application orchestration
layers.responsibility: Use cases, sequencing, lifecycle and transaction boundaries.

layers.name: Policy and capabilities
layers.responsibility: Authorization, resource limits, safety and allowed operations.

layers.name: Ports and contracts
layers.responsibility: Abstract platform, clock, storage, memory and device services.

layers.name: Adapters and platform
layers.responsibility: Concrete OS, CPU, board and hardware implementations.

layers.name: State and data
layers.responsibility: Persisted state, caller-owned memory, schemas and artifacts.

layers.name: Runtime and delivery
layers.responsibility: Build, boot, packaging, deployment and execution composition.

layers.name: Assurance and evidence
layers.responsibility: Tests, static analysis, resource proofs and target qualification.

vertical_slices.title: Component startup
vertical_slices.flow: Consumer registers callbacks → validate descriptor → initialize in order → expose RUNNING only after success.

vertical_slices.title: Bounded poll
vertical_slices.flow: Application schedules poll → reentrancy guard → one deterministic step → propagate status → optional external heartbeat.

vertical_slices.title: Fault and shutdown
vertical_slices.flow: Callback failure → retain FAULTED state → reject invalid transitions → controlled shutdown/cleanup with test evidence.

guardrails: CO is not a preemptive scheduler, RTOS, interrupt scheduler, watchdog manager or MMIO layer. The application serializes independent execution contexts. Optional Kloz/SaintSI bridges stay adapters; the CO core has no hard dependency on them.
status_note: Architecture mapping only; it does not assert new code or target qualification.
